name: Notification System
description: Pluggable base framework for aggregating, displaying and dispatching notifications: a NotificationProvider plugin type, notification_group config entities, a type-to-group mapping, and a current-user AJAX block. Storage and dispatch (mail, web push) are optional submodules.
project_description: The notification_system module provides a pluggable architecture for aggregating, displaying and sending notifications in Drupal. It is a base module for developers to surface notifications from their own modules. It doesn't matter where the notifications are stored, so notifications can live in the Drupal database, in external applications, or be generated on request. Everything is plugin based, so each module can implement its own NotificationProvider. Administrators bundle notification types into notification groups and show them to the user via a block (a notification center, a header dropdown, or wherever it is placed). The optional notification_system_dispatch submodule sends the gathered notifications out via 'dispatchers' – by email (notification_system_dispatch_mail) or web push (notification_system_dispatch_webpush); dispatchers are themselves an extensible plugin type, so a Slack or Teams dispatcher is possible. The notification_system_database submodule provides a stored Notification content entity plus admin UI. Web Push requires the web_push_api contrib module.
